dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Hello! Another beautiful day, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, quite lovely indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: If only every day could be as wonderful as today is!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No. If you ask me, it's a terrible day.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Don't be like that! The day isn't over yet. Do something that makes you happy. Then you can welcome tomorrow with a smile on your face.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: A happy end to today means a happy start to tomorrow. Isn't that great!

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Hey there! Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: I'm here to help people like you, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: All you newcomers, still holding the empty forms Ms. Monglane shoved at you, looking around like lost lambs. You need a friendly face to point you in the right direction, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: And who better than me, the former "Pretty Face," to perform this task?

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: I'll tell you something on the down low... You can't repeat it to anyone else! Ms. Monglane herself approves of my work. Not that she can admit to it in public, but I know...

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: That's definitely what she actually thinks!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Heard any interesting rumors?

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: You mean, apart from "Pretty Face" becoming "Dirty Face"? Ooh, let me think about that for a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Haha, just kidding. But honestly, I can't think of any rumors. It's all either big news you must have already heard, or tittle-tattle you wouldn't be interested in.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Hey, why don't you tell me some rumors?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't need any help with anything. Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Seems like you've already settled in here at the Fortress. That's great!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have nothing to say. Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Well, no news is good news. Everything is so peaceful!

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: I'm so happy to see you, friend!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Estienne's game...

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Congratulations on winning!

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Now that I think of it, I never even saw Caterpillar that much... I didn't know he had that many Coupons! I'm jealous! If only I had that many...

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: I'd treat everyone in the entire Fortress to new flavors of Fonta... No! I'd pay everyone's wages for a day and give them all a holiday!

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: Or maybe I'd sponsor an Invokation tournament? Oh, how can I choose between such good ideas... Oh! Why would I even have to choose? I can do them all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have something to do. Goodbye for now.

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: So diligent! Take care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Fortress of Meropide...

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: I actually like living here! When I was outside, I lived a life with my days and nights all topsy turvy, sleepless at night, dispirited and listless during the day...

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: But ever since I arrived in the Fortress of Meropide, I've led a regular and healthy life!

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: If you have had similar issues, I recommend you stay a while longer!
